title: Mutation: HW/SW Pin/Polarity Mismatch in HSI

revision_history.author: system_engineer
revision_history.description: Mutation scenario: HW/SW pin/polarity mismatch in HSI

revision_history.author: system_engineer
revision_history.description: Reconciled the expectation with the rule this scenario declares. declared detector 'HSI/SW interface consistency checker' -> rule id 'hsi_interface_consistency'; expected description restated as the message the declared rule emits. The rule is authoritative for severity and category. The scenario's injected defect, its affected artifacts and its declared detector rule are unchanged. This expectation had never been checked: the scenario harness matched any finding of the right severity on the right artifact id, so a standing finding on the same artifact satisfied it. Remediation of finding FB2-REV-FND-000032.

patch.description: Flip SPI polarity of HSI_AFE_SPI/SPI_CLK signal to CPOL=1, CPHA=1 contradicting the hardware requirement

expected_finding.description: HSI/HW interface mismatch for signal SPI_CLK (polarity): HSI=CPOL=1, CPHA=1, HW=CPOL=0, CPHA=1

impact_paths: SPI communication between master and AFE will fail
Cell voltage acquisition will read corrupted data
expected_remediation: Align HSI signal definition with HW TSR; update both HW and SW designs
